title: Scientist Immunopeptidomics*
description: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Scientist Immunopeptidomics* to join our Target Research and Development team in Tuebingen, Germany. Your work will combine experimental immunopeptidomics, quantitative proteomics and data interpretation to characterize HLA-presented targets, advance our platform toward future clinical applications and contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. Working closely with laboratory scientists, our mass spectrometry team and colleagues in Data Intelligence, you will develop robust analytical methods and help connect experimental work with reproducible data analysis. This is an opportunity to contribute your scientific expertise and ideas, explore new technologies and shape streamlined, digitally connected workflows that translate research findings into meaningful applications. This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Characterize and quantify HLA-presented peptides using Immatics’ proprietary absolute quantitation technology to support therapeutic target validation and the evaluation of biomarkers for patient selection and disease monitoring. Develop, optimize and validate immunopeptidomics methodologies using protein biochemistry and mass spectrometry, with a focus on reproducibility, scalability and the analysis of clinically relevant samples. Coordinate and manage target characterization activities across departments, aligning experimental plans, timelines and interpretation of results with laboratory, mass spectrometry and Data Intelligence colleagues. Establish suitable controls and performance criteria for new workflows, critically evaluate experimental results and document methods and findings to support their transfer into standardized laboratory processes. title: Senior/ Principal Manager Central Imaging*
description: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Principal Manager Central Imaging* to strengthen our Clinical Sciences team in the clinical development of innovative cancer immunotherapeutic products. You will work in an interdisciplinary environment with internal colleagues and external imaging vendors and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. The position can be filled in Tübingen, Munich or remote within Germany and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION You will independently manage central imaging activities for assigned global oncology trials and contribute scientific expertise to imaging endpoints and response assessments. Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Provide risk-based oversight of imaging vendors, monitoring image quality, query resolution, turnaround times, reader performance and adjudication metrics. Drive issue resolution and escalate risks impacting study milestones. Coordinate vendor and site readiness, including imaging systems, training, image submission processes, and review of imaging charters, manuals and project plans. Partner with Clinical Operations and vendors on site onboarding, imaging training and compliance with imaging procedures. Collaborate with Data Management and Biostatistics on imaging eCRFs, data specifications, reconciliation and transfers to ensure reliable endpoint data and timely analyses. Develop and implement central imaging strategies for assigned trials, aligning imaging endpoints, response criteria (e.g., RECIST 1.1, iRECIST) and operational requirements with study design. Provide imaging expertise for protocols, amendments, statistical analysis plans and regulatory documents, including radiation protection and patient-facing materials. Define imaging vendor requirements and support vendor qualification, selection and contracting in partnership with Vendor Management, Quality Assurance and Legal.

title: Senior/ Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing*
description: OVERVIEW We are currently seeking a Senior or Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing* to join our Clinical Sciences team with a primary focus on Phase III clinical trials and Biologics License Application (BLA) submissions. You will work in Tübingen, Munich or remote within Germany in an interdisciplinary environment with colleagues from clinical and non-clinical teams and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer. This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months. YOUR MISSION As a part of cross-functional teams, you will independently manage assigned medical writing activities mainly for late-stage clinical trials and associated regulatory submissions. Your main responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following tasks: Plan, author and coordinate clinical documents for BLA submissions ensuring a consistent presentation and interpretation of clinical data across documents. Prepare regulatory documents supporting Phase 3 as well as early clinical trials, clinical trial applications in Europe, and IND submissions in the USA, including clinical trial protocols and amendments, investigator’s brochures, and clinical sections of Investigational Medicinal Product Dossiers. Prepare briefing books for scientific advice meetings in Europe and the USA including meetings supporting late-stage development and BLA submission planning. Write medical and scientific sections, develop document strategies and coordinate cross-functional input, reviews and comment resolution. Manage document timelines, dependencies and deliverables to meet study and submission milestones. Provide medical writing oversight of external writers and vendors, including review of document plans and drafts, coordination of feedback, and monitoring of quality and timelines.
